title: Companies Appointment of Legal Advisers Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Companies Appointment of Legal Advisers Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1994
ACT IV OF 1994
COMPANIES (APPOINTMENT OF LEGAL ADVISERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act to amend the Companies
(Appointment of Legal Advisers) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
May, 1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Companies (Appointment of Legal Advisers) (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4, Act X of 1974

ACT IV OF 1994
ACT IV OF 1994
COMPANIES (APPOINTMENT OF LEGAL ADVISERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act to amend the Companies
(Appointment of Legal Advisers) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
May, 1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of
section 4, Act X of 1974.--In the Companies (Appointment of Legal Advisers)
Act, 1974 (X of 1974), in section 4, for the words "three hundred
fifty" the words "one thousand two hundred" shall be
substituted.
